SELECT operate_admin_log.id, COALESCE(operate_admin_log.subject_account, operate_admin_log.actor_account) AS login_code, operate_admin_log.actor_name AS login_name, operate_admin_log.module, operate_admin_log.title, operate_admin_log.resource, operate_admin_log.ip, operate_admin_log.type, operate_admin_log.exception, operate_admin_log.create_time FROM operate_admin_log
operate_admin_log.is_delete = 0 AND operate_admin_log.event_type = 'AUTHENTICATION'
AND operate_admin_log.create_time >= #{req.startTime}
AND operate_admin_log.create_time <= #{req.endTime}
AND COALESCE(operate_admin_log.subject_account, operate_admin_log.actor_account) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginCode}, '%')
AND operate_admin_log.actor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginName}, '%')
AND operate_admin_log.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.title}, '%')
ORDER BY operate_admin_log.id DESC
